name: Red Crystal

flag.description: A white field with a hollow red square standing on one corner, like a diamond, in the center.
flag.symbolism: The crystal was designed to carry no national, political or religious meaning, so it can mark the wounded and those who help them anywhere.

hook: The Red Crystal is a hollow red diamond on white, with no cross or crescent in sight.
trivia: It was created by the Third Additional Protocol to the Geneva Conventions, adopted in December 2005, which came into force in January 2007.
Israel's Magen David Adom uses the crystal abroad with its own red Star of David set inside it.
